text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Manages projects, configures integrations, and monitors the platform.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Issues REST API calls on behalf of the developer or admin.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Submits notification requests using project-scoped API keys.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Scrapes health and metrics endpoints for operational observability.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Persists all platform data including blackout periods and delivery windows.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Holds JWT blocklist, API key revocation list, and refresh token metadata for stateful auth. Also backs rate limiting and idempotency key checks. Hard auth dependency — unavailability causes fail-closed 503.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Verifies JWT signature first, then checks Redis blocklist for revocation. Fails closed with 503 if Redis is unreachable. Issues short-lived access tokens and longer-lived refresh tokens on login.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Manages project lifecycle and enforces project-scoped resource isolation across all other capabilities.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Creates, rotates, and revokes project-scoped API keys. On revocation writes to both Postgres and the Redis revocation list — fails the operation if either write fails.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Accepts, validates, and persists notification requests. Resolves templates and hands off to Scheduling.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Manages reusable notification templates with variable substitution and versioning, scoped per project.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Produces a candidate send time from an explicit send_at value, an ML-driven suggestion, or an immediate default. Owns timing only.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Evaluates candidate time against address availability, channel opt-outs, blackout periods, and delivery windows. Returns cleared time, adjusted time, or a policy rejection with a reason.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Serialises policy-cleared jobs, selects exchange and routing key per channel, and publishes to RabbitMQ with publisher confirms.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Manages client webhook endpoint registration and event subscriptions for delivery status callbacks.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Detects and rejects duplicate submissions across all mutating operations using client-supplied idempotency keys.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Exposes /health with live connectivity checks for Postgres, Redis, and RabbitMQ. Redis failure reported as unhealthy since auth depends on it. Exposes /metrics in Prometheus format.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;

text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Verifies signature then checks blocklist. Fails closed if Redis unreachable

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Writes revocation entry on key deletion
